title: The Long Path
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, sh, th, ng added, 35-sound stage.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow dragging his feet through gravel, marking out a straight long path.
Moss the hedgehog digging in short, scattered patches of gravel nearby, not in a line.
Moss the hedgehog standing beside his own wobbly, uneven gravel path.
Pip the sparrow standing beside Moss, both working on the same patch of gravel path together.
Moss the hedgehog and Pip the sparrow both moving quickly along the gravel path together.
A wide view of the finished gravel path, straight and tidy from end to end.
Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog sitting side by side on their finished path, pleased.
Moss the hedgehog and Pip the sparrow sitting together at the end of the finished gravel path.
